title: FactoryHorde validator
description: FactoryHorde validator on Refinery: pipeline liveness, rounds, weights, executor, Pylon and server.

panels.title: Validator
panels.description: Application readiness reported by the validator (`factory_horde_ready`). No data means the validator is not being scraped.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health per target: validator, Pylon and node-exporter.

panels.title: Round phase
panels.description: Latest persisted round phase.

panels.title: Active jobs
panels.description: Factory and judge jobs currently held.

panels.title: Unresolved jobs
panels.description: Jobs whose outcome is not yet known; old unresolved jobs hold new round slots.

panels.title: Blocked next round
panels.description: 1 when unresolved work blocks the next round from starting.

panels.title: Usable scores
panels.description: Accepted scores in the latest usable completed round, i.e. miners that can receive weight.

panels.title: Usable round age
panels.description: Time since the latest usable completed round. With 30-minute rounds this should stay below about an hour.

panels.title: Validator uptime
panels.description: Time since the validator process started.

panels.title: Last activity
panels.description: When each step of the validator pipeline last happened, looking back 7 days. Chain beats arrive every block; round steps once per 30-minute round; weights once per tempo (72 minutes). 'Container started' and 'Job finished' cover both factory and judge jobs. 'Weights on chain' is Pylon's successful commit/set extrinsic.

panels.title: Activity timeline
panels.description: Pipeline events per time bucket (Prometheus `increase`, so counts are approximate).

panels.title: Observation age
panels.description: Age of the validator's latest runtime observations; -1 means absent. Readiness fails above 30 s.

panels.title: Readiness checks
panels.description: Individual readiness checks over time.

panels.title: Round phase
panels.description: Latest persisted round phase over time.

panels.title: Commitment discovery
panels.description: Discovery snapshots and the miner submissions they accepted or rejected.

panels.title: Coordinator events
panels.description: Round admission, factory eligibility decisions (factory_timely/late/failed), skipped evaluations, reconciliation and errors.

panels.title: Result operations
panels.description: Accepted-score finalization (pending while the judge runs), projections and rebuilds.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: Job and score gauges.

panels.title: Weight pipeline
panels.description: Weight opportunities (skipped without usable scores), calculations, Pylon acknowledgements and Pylon's apply-weights jobs.

panels.title: Usable round age
panels.description: Time since the latest usable completed round; -1 means none.

panels.title: Docker operations
panels.description: Docker CLI calls made by the systemd executor (forwarded through the validator).

panels.title: Docker operation errors
panels.description: Non-ok Docker calls. Occasional 'container' errors are inspections of containers that no longer exist.

panels.title: Docker operation latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile Docker call latency; pulls include image downloads.

panels.title: Chain operations
panels.description: Pylon's subtensor calls per second.

panels.title: Pylon requests
panels.description: Validator requests to Pylon's API per second.

panels.title: Shared-record operations
panels.description: File-record I/O between the validator and the executor.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the validator and Pylon processes.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the validator and Pylon processes.

panels.title: Health checks
panels.description: Readiness samples by outcome.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: eth0 is the public interface, eth1 the Refinery VLAN.
